content.rendered:
Mission Statement

The Sherwood School District strives to meet the intellectual, academic, and emotional needs of the students in our district who have been identified as Academically Talented or Intellectually Gifted in accordance with Oregon State Statutes.

Important Links:

For more information please contact:

Nanci Stauffer

K-12 TAG Coordinator

nstauffer@sherwood.k12.or.us

(503) 825-5015
